label: def:quaternionic-spectral-resolvents
title: Quaternionic spectral resolvents
html:
Let \mathcal{S} denote Bring's surface (Bring's surface). Let q\in\mathbb{C} with 0<\lvert q\rvert\le 1, and set r=-\ln\lvert q\rvert so that \lvert q\rvert=e^{-r}. Write \mathbf{i},\mathbf{j},\mathbf{k} for the standard basis of \mathrm{Im}\mathbb{H}. Using the Lusztig q-exponential and q-logarithm,

\exp_q(x)= \sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\frac{x^n}{[n]_q!},
  \qquad
  \ln_q(1+x)= \sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(-1)^{n+1}\frac{x^n}{[n]_q},

we define the quaternionic spectral resolvents \omega_k\colon\mathcal{S}\to J^\infty E by

\begin{align}
  \omega_0 &= 
    \Bigl(\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\!\sum_{j=0}^{4}x_j\Bigr)
    \ln_q(1+r)
    &&\text{(uncertainty),}
    \\[4pt]
  \omega_1 &= 
    \frac{\mathbf{i}}{\ln_q(1+r)}
    \Bigl(\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\!\sum_{j=0}^{4}\zeta^{j}x_j+i\Bigr)
    &&\text{(space-like),}
    \\[4pt]
  \omega_2 &= 
    \mathbf{j}
    \Bigl(\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\!\sum_{j=0}^{4}\zeta^{2j}x_j+i\Bigr)
    \bigl(\exp_q(r)-1\bigr)
    &&\text{(time-like),}
    \\[4pt]
  \omega_3 &= 
    \mathbf{k}
    \Bigl(\tfrac{1}{\sqrt{5}}\!\sum_{j=0}^{4}\zeta^{3j}x_j+i\Bigr)
    \bigl(\exp_q(r)-1\bigr)
    &&\text{(time-like).}
    
\end{align}

By the first power sum, \omega_0=0 in the balanced state. The remaining coordinates embed \mathcal{S} into the infinite jet shell J^\infty E (jet shell).
